description: This file defines an Angular standalone component 'NoteCardComponent' which displays a note with options to edit or delete. It uses Input for note data and outputs events for edit and delete actions.

classes.name: NoteCardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that renders a note card with title, content, and action buttons.

methods.name: edit.emit
methods.description: Emits an event to trigger editing of the note.

methods.name: remove.emit
methods.description: Emits an event to trigger removal of the note.
